name: ONLYOFFICE Workspace
description_en:
ONLYOFFICE Workspace is a self-hosted bundle that combines document management and editing with Mail, CRM, Projects, Calendar and portal administration. Its document editors are one component of a wider workspace, with separate membership, sharing and operational settings.

A proposed client proposal can move from a CRM contact to project tasks and a shared document, but the document’s access rights still matter. This profile covers Workspace-specific material; the Docs product banner, DocSpace room model and free Desktop Editors should not be assumed to define the Workspace bundle’s version, license or entitlements.
description_zh:
ONLYOFFICE Workspace 是自托管套件，把文档管理及编辑与 Mail、CRM、Projects、Calendar 和门户管理结合。文档编辑器只是较大工作区的一个组件，成员、共享及运行设置各有边界。

假设制作客户方案，可从 CRM 联系人转到项目任务及共享文档，但文档权限仍需处理。本稿采用 Workspace 专属材料，不能根据 Docs 产品横幅、DocSpace 房间模型或免费 Desktop Editors 推断 Workspace 的版本、许可及资格。

sections.title_en: Follow a proposal through the workspace
sections.title_zh: 沿客户方案贯穿工作区
sections.en:
For a proposed service engagement, use CRM to organize the customer, Projects to create a milestone and tasks, and Documents to hold the draft proposal. The product pages describe attaching documents to CRM tasks or email and editing them from Projects. That linkage supports a single working context but does not establish that every task, contact and document has identical permissions.

Projects includes subtasks, custom statuses, dependencies, Gantt views and time reports. Use those to evaluate an actual small delivery rather than infer portfolio forecasting or capacity planning. Mail aggregation/server setup and calendar connections also need their own configuration. No project, contact, mailbox or document was created.
sections.zh:
假设开展服务项目，可用 CRM 整理客户，Projects 建立里程碑及任务，Documents 保存方案草稿。产品页描述把文档附到 CRM 任务或邮件，也可从 Projects 编辑。关联能形成统一工作上下文，但不证明任务、联系人和文档权限完全相同。

Projects 含子任务、自定义状态、依赖、甘特视图及时间报告，应用于评估实际小交付，不能推断组合预测或资源容量规划。邮件聚合／服务器及日历连接也需独立配置。本研究未创建项目、联系人、邮箱或文档。

sections.title_en: Pending registration can still mean active collaboration
sections.title_zh: 待确认注册仍可能参与协作
sections.en:
The People guide distinguishes content-creating users from view-only guests. Pending members have not confirmed the registration email but can log in and collaborate; they do not receive email notifications. Disabled members cannot log in. A missing notification is therefore not reliable evidence that a person has no access.

For a proposed client review, determine whether the person needs a portal account or a specific external document link, and verify the effective rights rather than treating the guest label as editing permission. The guide includes older cloud billing remarks, which are not evidence of a current hosted Workspace offer. Actual user counting and edition entitlements require confirmation.
sections.zh:
People 指南区分可创建内容的用户与仅查看访客。Pending 成员尚未确认注册邮箱，但可登录及协作，只是不收邮件通知；Disabled 成员不能登录。因此缺少通知不能可靠证明某人没有访问权。

假设邀请客户审阅，应确定需门户账户还是特定外部文档链接，并检查实际权限，不能把访客标签当成编辑权。指南含旧云版计费说明，不构成当前托管 Workspace 方案证据。实际用户计数及版本资格需确认。

sections.title_en: A reviewer, a full-access user and a quick link behave differently
sections.title_zh: 审阅者、完整权限用户及快捷链接行为不同
sections.en:
For a DOCX proposal, Review keeps tracked changes enabled and does not let reviewers accept or reject their own suggestions; the owner or a full-access user resolves them. Ordinary Full Access can include resharing, subject to advanced settings, and folder Full Access does not allow deletion by default.

Create a named external link when password or expiry control is required. The quick external link uses the configured default rights and lacks the normal password, time-limit and rename options. A shared folder’s nested contents inherit its external link. Deleting a link removes that path, not the file itself or every other grant. Check the intended recipient experience and other active links before treating a review as closed. No external sharing or tracked change was performed.
sections.zh:
DOCX 方案采用 Review 时，修订保持开启，审阅者不能采纳或拒绝自己的建议，需所有者或 Full Access 用户处理。普通 Full Access 可能包含再次共享，但受高级设置限制，文件夹 Full Access 默认不允许删除。

需要密码或到期控制时，应建立有名称的外部链接。快捷外部链接采用配置的默认权限，没有普通链接的密码、期限及改名选项。共享文件夹的嵌套内容继承外部链接。删除链接会移除该路径，不删除文件本身，也不移除全部其他授权。应检查目标接收者体验及其他活动链接，再认定审阅结束。本研究未共享或执行修订。

sections.title_en: Private Room changes access, clients and recovery
sections.title_zh: Private Room 改变访问、客户端及恢复方式
sections.en:
Private Room is documented for the server edition through Desktop Editors, not ordinary browser editing. Users need compatible desktop support and generated keys; the guide says SSO/third-party sign-in is unavailable in this configuration. Current pricing includes Private Rooms in Enterprise, but the older minimum-version/paid-desktop wording does not establish universal Community eligibility.

The room permits internal sharing only with Full Access and appropriately initialized users; it does not support external links. Files are deleted permanently without Trash and previous versions cannot be restored. This changes the proposal workflow: an external reviewer cannot simply use the same public link inside the encrypted room. Validate the required access and exit behavior before storing important originals. Encryption statements remain vendor documentation, not an audited security result; nothing was installed, encrypted or deleted.
sections.zh:
文档规定 Private Room 用于服务器版，经 Desktop Editors 使用，不是普通网页编辑。用户需兼容的桌面支持及已生成密钥，指南称此配置不支持 SSO／第三方登录。当前 Enterprise 定价包含 Private Rooms，但较旧的最低版本／付费桌面措辞不确立 Community 普遍资格。

该房间只向已初始化的内部用户提供 Full Access 共享，不支持外部链接。删除直接永久生效，不进回收站，旧版本也不能恢复。这会改变方案流程，外部审阅者无法沿用加密房间中的公开链接。保存重要原稿前应验证所需访问和退出行为。加密说法属于厂商文档，不是安全审计结果；未安装、加密或删除任何内容。

sections.title_en: The workspace installer provisions a multi-component system
sections.title_zh: 工作区安装器会配置多个组件
sections.en:
The Community Docker guide lists at least four CPU cores, 8GB RAM, 40GB free disk and 6GB swap for the documented bundle. It requires root privileges and can install or update Docker; Mail additionally needs a valid service domain and DNS configuration. Mail can be omitted. These instructions should be reviewed for the intended host, not pasted into an existing server on the strength of a product tour.

The browser download page shows different build labels for the main packages and marketplace images. A global Docs version banner is not the installed Workspace build or proof of current security patches. Confirm component compatibility, update source, storage, TLS and mail requirements for the exact deployment. No script, container or marketplace image was run.
sections.zh:
Community Docker 指南为所述套件列出至少四核 CPU、8GB 内存、40GB 可用磁盘及6GB 交换空间，要求 root 权限，并可能安装或更新 Docker。Mail 还需有效服务域名和 DNS，可选择不装邮件。应按目标主机审查步骤，不能仅凭产品导览就在既有服务器粘贴执行。

浏览器下载页对主要安装包与市场镜像显示不同构建标签。全站 Docs 版本横幅不是已安装 Workspace 构建，也不证明安全补丁已更新。应确认精确部署的组件兼容性、更新源、存储、TLS 及邮件要求。本研究未运行脚本、容器或市场镜像。

sections.title_en: Portal backups need mail scope, licenses and the original key
sections.title_zh: 门户恢复依赖邮件范围、许可及原密钥
sections.en:
The Control Panel guide offers manual or scheduled backups to configured storage. Include Mail is optional: omitting it loses Mail data on restore and requires reconnecting accounts, with additional platform-specific mail steps. License data is excluded and must be uploaded again. Temporary backup downloads last 24 hours.

The guide says a backup made with disk encryption enabled contains decrypted files, so the archive needs its own protected destination; do not generalize that statement into an unverified Private Room key-recovery guarantee. A new-server restore requires the original machine key for encrypted account passwords. Preserving only the archive is therefore insufficient. Test a disposable restore including mail access, license and authentication, while checking the exact platform’s procedure. No backup, key extraction or restoration was performed.
sections.zh:
Control Panel 指南支持手动／定时备份到已配置存储。Include Mail 为可选，未选时恢复会丢失 Mail 数据，需重连账户，且另有平台专属邮件步骤。许可数据不在备份内，须重新上传。临时备份下载链接有效24小时。

指南称启用磁盘加密时生成的备份包含解密文件，因此归档需有独立受保护目标；不能把该说明扩展为未经验证的 Private Room 密钥恢复保证。新服务器恢复还需原 machine key 处理已加密账户密码，仅保存归档不够。应按精确平台流程，在可丢弃副本测试包含邮件、许可及身份验证的恢复。本研究未备份、提取密钥或恢复。

sections.title_en: Lifetime use is listed alongside one year of updates and support
sections.title_zh: 终身使用与一年更新支持并列
sections.en:
The Workspace-specific pricing page shows Enterprise, Enterprise Plus and Enterprise Premium as lifetime licenses per server, priced upon request, with 50 users initially selected. It includes one year of updates and support and a 30-day trial. No current public amount was established, so old third-party starting prices were removed.

A lifetime label does not establish perpetual updates, support or unlimited user/server capacity. Ask the vendor to define user counting, included editor capacity, support renewal, scaling, tax and cancellation/refund terms in the actual quote. The Premium clustering footnote describes consulting for active/passive configuration rather than automatic high availability. Community software and free desktop apps are separate offers; their availability does not include commercial support or free hosting. No quotation was requested or purchase made.
sections.zh:
Workspace 专属定价页把 Enterprise、Enterprise Plus 和 Enterprise Premium 列为每服务器终身许可、金额询价，初始选择50用户，含一年更新及支持，试用30天。未确立当前公开金额，因此移除了旧第三方起价。

“终身”不确立永久更新、支持或无限用户／服务器容量。实际报价应明确用户计数、编辑器容量、支持续费、扩容、税及取消／退款。Premium 集群脚注描述 active/passive 配置咨询，不是自动高可用。Community 软件及免费桌面应用是独立方案，不包含商业支持或免费托管。本研究未询价或购买。

sections.title_en: Read component licenses rather than one bundle label
sections.en:
The official component README identifies Groups/Community Server, Docs/Document Server, Mail, Talk and Control Panel as parts of Workspace. Groups’ inspected license is Apache 2.0. The inspected Docs license is AGPLv3 with additional notice, modification and UI-attribution conditions, no trademark grant and separate licensing for specified non-code content. Neither license alone defines every component or the Enterprise build.

Keep the whole-bundle open-source flag unset until the exact distribution is chosen; the known open components remain documented. Workspace fits a team that wants linked business modules and can operate the stack or obtain qualified hosting. A requirement for purely browser-based encrypted review, effortless recovery or a simple fixed SaaS bill needs a more specific offer and validation. Model/AI routing, complete export, service guarantees and regional agreements remain unverified.
sections.zh:
官方组件 README 将 Groups／Community Server、Docs／Document Server、Mail、Talk 和 Control Panel 列为 Workspace 组成。所读 Groups 许可为 Apache2.0；Docs 为 AGPLv3，附加通知、修改标记和界面归属条件，不授商标权，并对特定非代码内容另设许可。任一许可证都不能定义全部组件或 Enterprise 构建。

应在选定精确发行包前把整套开源标记留空，同时保留已知开放组件事实。Workspace 适合需要关联业务模块、能运营该组件栈或取得合适托管的团队。纯网页加密审阅、简便恢复或固定 SaaS 总账单，需要更具体方案及验证。模型／AI 路由、完整导出、服务保证及地区协议仍未核实。
